title: Envy-free, efficient and strategy-proof division of a heterogeneous good between two agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.06059v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the division of $[0,1]$ between two agents, each receiving a closed subinterval, under ordinal preferences that need not be additive. A monotonic preference has a unique balanced cut, at which the agent is indifferent between the left and the right piece. On a domain of monotonic preferences, a strategy-proof, envy-free and Pareto efficient rule exists if and only if the balanced cuts of the preferences in the domain take at most two distinct values; when they take exactly two, the divide-and-choose rules are the only such rules. For preferences single-peaked in quantity, which are additive only if monotonic, the three properties are compatible when the agents' most preferred bundles can be assigned simultaneously.

translated_title: 两个代理人之间无嫉妒、有效且策略防操纵的异质物品分配
translated_abstract: 我们研究两个代理人之间对区间 $[0,1]$ 的分配问题，每个代理人获得一个闭子区间，并在不一定可加的序数偏好下进行。单调偏好具有唯一的平衡切点，在该切点处，代理人对左边和右边的部分无差异。在单调偏好域上，策略防操纵、无嫉妒且帕累托有效的规则存在当且仅当域中偏好的平衡切点至多取两个不同的值；当它们恰好取两个值时，分而选之规则是唯一满足这三条性质的规则。对于在数量上单峰的偏好（这类偏好只有单调时才是可加的），当代理人最偏好的束可以同时被分配时，这三种性质是相容的。
tldr: 该论文证明了在两个代理人之间分配异质物品时，策略防操纵、无嫉妒和帕累托有效的规则存在当且仅当偏好的平衡切点至多取两个不同值，且此时分而选之规则是唯一满足这三条性质的规则。
en_tdlr: A strategy-proof, envy-free, and Pareto efficient rule for dividing a heterogeneous good between two agents exists if and only if the balanced cuts of preferences take at most two distinct values, in which case divide-and-choose rules are the only such rules.
